multiTargetDamageFalloff.displayText: Each target takes full damage while N ≤ T. When N > T, each target takes √(T ÷ N) of the damage. T is the threshold and N is the number of targets hit.

symbols.meaning: Scaler on the damage each target takes.
Threshold, truncated to a whole number. Up to T targets each take full damage.
Number of targets hit. An ability with max targets hits at most that many.
